nested_hole_adapter_trial.protocol: Release crate-only rebuild after warming dependencies; CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=15; CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/target-Hole; TMPDIR=/private/tmp; caffeinate; -Ztime-passes -Csave-temps -Cmetadata=UNIQUE_TAG; one cargo command at a time; 900-second build cap.
nested_hole_adapter_trial.cgu_metric: Largest saved preoptimization .rcgu.no-opt.bc bytes divided by all 16 CGUs.
nested_hole_adapter_trial.runtime_protocol: Three interleaved AB/BA/AB pairs, compute-only seconds, no concurrent build or benchmark.
nested_hole_adapter_trial.decision: Keep print_hole optional: largest CGU remains above 51%, not below 48%; compile wall/CPU increased and Cassandra sequential median increased 4.96%, so unchanged runtime is not established.
nested_hole_adapter_trial.default_expansion: DOOP doop-mini expansion byte-identical to 49d0ebd (2057532 bytes).
nested_hole_adapter_trial.exact_checks: All six DOOP applications passed full 26-relation tuple-set comparison against Ascent, sequential and 15-thread parallel.
